beats.text: Think kink is niche? Not even close.
A nationally representative survey asked over two thousand American adults what they had ever tried.
At least thirty percent had tried spanking.
More than one in five had tried role play. About one in five, being tied up or tying someone up.
And women and men reported these at similar rates.
So what you call kinky? For millions of people, it's just Tuesday. The one rule that matters: consent.

sources: Herbenick, Bowling, Fu, Dodge, Guerra-Reyes & Sanders (2017). Sexual diversity in the United States: Results from a nationally representative probability sample of adult women and men. PLoS ONE 12(7): e0181198. N = 2,021 (975 men, 1,046 women), GfK KnowledgePanel 2015. Lifetime: spanking >=30%, role-playing >=22%, tying up/being tied up >=20%. Spanking 34% women / 30% men; tying 21% / 22% (via Sex & Psychology, Lehmiller).
